$description: The area map (plan C4). make map-fetch downloads OpenStreetMap data into packages/map/source and pins it in map.lock.json; make map builds packages/map/dist offline from that. The river is drawn without its name, as the brief asks. Routes are driving routes from each area to its nearer centre (packages/site/areas.json). The attribution must show wherever the map does.

endpoints.$description: Overpass lists the main server and its public mirrors, tried in order: the main one is often busy.

rivers.$description: Rivers drawn, by OpenStreetMap name (matched as a pattern, so both spellings of the Pavana are listed). Drawn without names.

geocode.$description: How each area is found. The default query is the area name with its hub's city; overrides fix names that land in the wrong place.

centres.$description: A centre's pin comes from its confirmed geo fact. A new centre without one needs a query here, which gives an approximate point, marked as such. Both centres have confirmed pins (2026-10-31).

commuteCheck.$description: make map warns when a commute in packages/site/areas.json differs from the road route from the pinned centre by more than both limits, or when another centre is nearer by road by more than absoluteKm. D-SAP decides what to change.

style.$description: Stroke widths, dashes, point sizes and label sizes in map units (the map is svg.width units wide). Used by the preview area-map.svg and by the site, which takes colours from the surface roles.
